name: MarineCadastre.gov Vessel Traffic (AIS) - BOEM + NOAA OCM, from USCG NAIS
coverage: US waters + nearby international waters (USCG terrestrial receivers)
kind: historical daily point files (CSV in zip, ~180-310 MB/day); newest day 2024-12-31 (2025 folder 404 on 2026-11-26)
licence_quote: 'The information on government web pages is in the public domain and not subject to copyright protection within the United States unless specifically annotated otherwise'
notes: 17 U.S.C. 403 notice required when a work consists predominantly of this material; included in attribution. Fields include MMSI/name/IMO/callsign - we drop them.

name: Fintraffic Digitraffic marine AIS (Finland / Baltic)
coverage: Finnish waters + Baltic Sea (Finnish AIS network)
kind: LIVE REST: /api/ais/v1/locations (GeoJSON, latest position per vessel), /api/ais/v1/vessels (metadata incl. shipType); MQTT wss://meri.digitraffic.fi:443/mqtt
licence_quote: 'licensed under the Creative Commons 4.0 By license. It gives the right to distribute, remix, tweak, and build upon our data, even commercially'
attribution_required: Source: Fintraffic / digitraffic.fi, license CC 4.0 BY
used: proposed for live browser fetch (not built into a file)
notes: No history/track endpoint for positions (locations = latest only); trails must be built from successive polls. Vessels metadata contains names/callsign/IMO - do not display.

name: Kystverket (Norwegian Coastal Administration) open AIS
coverage: Norwegian waters, EEZ, Svalbard, Jan Mayen (excludes fishing <15 m and leisure <45 m)
kind: LIVE raw NMEA TCP stream 153.44.253.27:5631; BarentsWatch AIS API (OAuth client registration)
login_or_key: TCP none; BarentsWatch API needs client registration
licence_quote: 'Data er gratis og tilgjengelig for alle, og dataene er regulert under Norsk Lisens for offentlige data - NLOD.' (data free for all, under NLOD; credit Kystverket)
verdict: GREEN (licence) - not usable from a static browser page (raw TCP); would need a server-side collector

name: Danish Maritime Authority AIS (web.ais.dk/aisdata)
licence_quote: not verified - web.ais.dk refused in browser; dma.dk AIS page shows no licence wording

name: aisstream.io
licence_quote: no data licence published (only a privacy policy linked; /terms 404)

name: AISHub

verdict: RED (access only in exchange for operating an AIS receiver; custom terms, no open licence)

name: Global Fishing Watch APIs
